newsitem.title: VATICAN: Albania's Fino meets Pope on Balkan crisis. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Albania's Fino meets Pope on Balkan crisis. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]

text.p: Albanian Prime Minister Bashkim Fino briefed Pope John Paul on Tuesday on the crisis in his Balkan country and the Pontiff told him that the local Catholic Church would do all it could to help.
Fino, who is in Rome to meet European foreign ministers visiting Italy for the 40th anniversary of the founding of the European Economic Community, had asked to see the Pope, the Vatican said.
A statement said Fino told the Pope of the "dramatic situation" in Albania.

The Pope told Fino (corrects from Bashkim) that the local church would collaborate with authorities to help the population and that the Vatican would continue its appeals to the international community on behalf of Albania.
The Pope visited Albania in 1993 after the fall of communism in what had been Europe's last Stalinist state.
Catholics in Albania number about 300,000 among the predominantly Moslem population of some 3 million.
The Vatican said the Pope had sent Archbishop Agostino Marchetto to the Albanian capital Tirana as his "personal representative" until the Holy See's new ambassador to the country arrives.
